entries.en: Added a `maxProseWidth` setting that caps the width of Claude's prose in wide terminals while tables and code blocks keep the full width
entries.zh: 添加了`maxProseWidth`设置，该设置限制宽终端中克劳德散文的宽度，而表格和代码块保持完整宽度

entries.en: Added a startup notice, and `/status` and `claude doctor` entries, listing telemetry variables in a project's settings files that were ignored or that turned telemetry off
entries.zh: 添加了启动通知以及`/status`和`claude doctor`条目，列出了项目设置文件中被忽略或关闭遥测的遥测变量

entries.en: Added the `allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp` managed setting to let `claude --chrome` run alongside an exclusive `managed-mcp.json`; the error shown when Chrome is blocked now names it
entries.zh: 添加了`allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp`托管设置，让`claude --chrome`与独占的“management-mcp.json”一起运行； Chrome 被阻止时显示的错误现在将其命名

entries.en: Added `store.readiness_grace_seconds` to the Claude apps gateway so `/readyz` can stay ready through a short Postgres outage such as a database failover
entries.zh: 将`store.readiness_grace_seconds`添加到 Claude 应用程序网关，以便`/readyz`可以在短暂的 Postgres 中断（例如数据库故障转移）中保持就绪状态

entries.en: Added a scrollbar to the `/feedback` drafts list in fullscreen mode; it appears while the mouse is over the list
entries.zh: 在全屏模式下为`/feedback`草稿列表添加了滚动条；当鼠标悬停在列表上时它会出现

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Added Claude GitHub App status to Settings › Connectors › GitHub: whether the app is installed and reachable for your account, plus steps to connect, install or reconnect
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 在 Settings › Connectors › GitHub 中新增 Claude GitHub App 状态：显示应用是否已安装且对你的账户可用，并提供连接、安装或重新连接的步骤

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Added "Open repository" and "Open compare page" links to the repository menu of a cloud session whose repository is hosted on a Git server other than GitHub
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 对于托管在 GitHub 以外 Git 服务器上的仓库，云端会话的仓库菜单新增「Open repository」和「Open compare page」链接

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Added attaching a repository from a different GitHub owner, such as a fork's upstream, to a running cloud session that already has one, including sessions started from Slack
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 运行中的云端会话（包括从 Slack 发起的会话）若已有仓库，现在可以再附加一个来自其他 GitHub 所有者的仓库，例如 fork 的上游仓库

entries.en: Improved the time to resume very large sessions, including ones that were never compacted
entries.zh: 改进恢复超大会话（包括从未压缩过的会话）时的速度

entries.en: Improved the error shown on Windows when a session can't be resumed because its transcript file could not be read (EBADF): it now names possible causes and what to try
entries.zh: 改进 Windows 上会话无法恢复（转录文件无法读取，EBADF）时的报错：会列出可能原因和可尝试的操作

entries.en: Improved the Claude Desktop unknown-model error to suggest switching to a different model
entries.zh: 改进 Claude Desktop 的未知模型报错：建议切换到其他模型

entries.en: Improved rendering of unusual Unicode in permission prompts
entries.zh: 改进权限提示中罕见 Unicode 字符的显示

entries.en: Improved `/artifacts`: titles line up in one column, details are dropped whole instead of cut mid-word, and the list supports PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, the mouse wheel and clicks
entries.zh: 改进 `/artifacts`：标题对齐成一列，详情整段显示或整段隐藏（不再在词中间截断）；列表支持 PgUp/PgDn、Home/End、鼠标滚轮和点击

entries.en: Updated the `claude-api` skill: pre-output refusal billing now links to the How refusals are billed docs, mid-stream refusals bill at normal rates, and pre-output refusals count against rate limits
entries.zh: `claude-api` 技能：拒绝前输出的计费现在链接到“拒绝如何计费”文档；流式输出中途的拒绝按正常费率计费；输出前的拒绝计入速率限制

entries.en: Updated the `claude-api` skill to recommend `ant apply` for keeping Managed Agents resources as version-controlled files
entries.zh: `claude-api` 技能现在推荐使用 `ant apply` 将 Managed Agents 资源保存为受版本控制的文件

entries.en: Changed auto mode to use the server-side classifier by default on a direct Anthropic API connection when telemetry is off (`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` opts out)
entries.zh: 更改了自动模式，以便在遥测关闭时在直接 Anthropic API 连接上默认使用服务器端分类器（`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` 选择退出）

entries.en: Changed `sandbox.excludedCommands` to ignore project and local settings entries when managed settings or `--settings` set `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`, or managed `allowManagedDomainsOnly: true`
entries.zh: 更改了`sandbox.excludedCommands`，以在托管设置或`--settings`设置`allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`或托管`allowManagedDomainsOnly: true`时忽略项目和本地设置条目

entries.en: Changed project and local settings to ignore OpenTelemetry variables that turn on export, set its endpoint, or capture content, like `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY` and `OTEL_LOG_*`
entries.zh: 更改了项目和本地设置以忽略打开导出、设置端点或捕获内容的 OpenTelemetry 变量，例如`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY`和`OTEL_LOG_*`

entries.en: Changed Windows/WSL managed settings so an admin policy that is present but invalid or unreadable (HKLM, `managed-settings.json`) keeps user-writable HKCU and WSL `/etc/claude-code` from applying
entries.zh: 更改了 Windows/WSL 托管设置，以便存在但无效或不可读的管理策略（HKLM、“托管设置.json”）阻止用户可写的 HKCU 和 WSL`/etc/claude-code`应用

entries.en: Changed `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` allow rules to cover only skills synced from claude.ai, not plugins or other skills that merely use such a name
entries.zh: 更改了 `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` 和 `Skill(claude-ai:*)` 允许规则仅涵盖从 claude.ai 同步的技能，而不涵盖仅使用此类名称的插件或其他技能

entries.en: Changed skill folders, command files and workflow commands in the `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai` namespace to no longer load; a plugin so named still loads but yields name ties to synced skills
entries.zh: 更改了`anthropic-skills`或`claude-ai`命名空间中的技能文件夹、命令文件和工作流命令，不再加载；如此命名的插件仍然会加载，但会产生与同步技能相关的名称

entries.en: Changed MCP servers configured under the name `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai` to list no skills or prompts (their tools still work); rename the server in your MCP configuration to list them again
entries.zh: 更改了以`anthropic-skills`或`claude-ai`名称配置的 MCP 服务器，以不列出任何技能或提示（他们的工具仍然有效）；重命名 MCP 配置中的服务器以再次列出它们

entries.en: Changed the `ultracode` visuals in `/effort` and the prompt input to plain styling (no ripple, border flourish or keyword glimmer) and removed the dynamic-workflows spinner tip
entries.zh: 将`/effort`中的`ultracode`视觉效果和提示输入更改为简单样式（无波纹、边框华丽或关键字闪烁），并删除了动态工作流程微调器提示

entries.en: Changed the Clawd mascot's feet in the start-up banner to sit under the corners of his body
entries.zh: 将初创横幅中 Clawd 吉祥物的脚改为坐在他的身体角落下

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved how quickly the Routines page and the sidebar's Scheduled list load for accounts whose past sessions scheduled many check-in reminders
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 改进过去会话安排了大量签到提醒的账户，其 Routines 页面和侧边栏 Scheduled 列表的加载速度

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the bordered cards Claude uses in Slack replies for plans, tables and details to render wide by default instead of a narrow width
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude 在 Slack 回复中用于计划、表格和详情的带边框卡片，默认改为宽版显示，不再是窄版

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed newly connected Slack workspaces to follow the current default model instead of keeping whichever model was the default when they were connected
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 新连接的 Slack 工作区改为跟随当前默认模型，而不是保留连接时的默认模型

entries.en: Fixed every request failing with a 400 error in conversations whose history holds web search results the API cannot decrypt (for example, from a turn answered through a third-party gateway)
entries.zh: 修复了历史记录包含 API 无法解密的 Web 搜索结果的对话中每个请求失败并出现 400 错误的问题（例如，通过第三方网关应答的回合）

entries.en: Fixed more cases of continued or resumed sessions (`--continue`, `--resume`) re-sending earlier messages in a changed form, which could make the API drop Claude's earlier reasoning
entries.zh: 修复了更多继续或恢复会话（`--continue`、`--resume`）以更改的形式重新发送早期消息的情况，这可能使 API 放弃 Claude 早期的推理

entries.en: Fixed earlier extended thinking being dropped when `/model`, `/rename`, `/artifacts` or another immediate slash command was used while Claude was working
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德工作时使用`/model`、`/rename`、`/artifacts`或其他直接斜杠命令时早期扩展思维被丢弃的问题

entries.en: Fixed continued or resumed conversations losing earlier extended thinking when relaunched with a `--tools` list that leaves out a built-in tool offered earlier in the conversation
entries.zh: 修复了当使用`--tools`列表重新启动时，继续或恢复的对话会丢失早期的扩展思维，该列表遗漏了对话中先前提供的内置工具

entries.en: Fixed sessions failing on every turn with an "Invalid `data` in `redacted_thinking` block" API error; Claude Code now drops the conversation's thinking blocks and retries once
entries.zh: 修复了会话每次都会失败并出现“`redacted_thinking` 块中的无效‘数据’”API 错误的问题；克劳德·科德现在会放弃对话的思维障碍并重试一次

entries.en: Fixed compaction failing when the summarization request is refused; it now retries on a fallback model
entries.zh: 修复了汇总请求被拒绝时压缩失败的问题；它现在重试后备模型

entries.en: Fixed a failed turn ("Effort 'xhigh' isn't available with thinking turned off") after a safety-related model switch in sessions with thinking off and effort above high
entries.zh: 修复了在思考关闭且努力高于高的会话中进行安全相关模型切换后失败的转弯（“思考关闭时，努力‘xhigh’不可用”）

entries.en: Fixed an unanswered Fable usage-credits prompt switching models in SDK-hosted sessions such as Claude Desktop; the turn now ends instead, and Remote Control clients now see the model-switch notice
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 托管会话（例如 Claude Desktop）中未答复的《神鬼寓言》使用积分提示切换模型的问题；回合现在结束，远程控制客户端现在会看到模型切换通知

entries.en: Fixed `/model` with a full Fable model id stopping at an API error instead of opening the usage-credits prompt when the plan needs usage credits that aren't turned on yet
entries.zh: 修复了带有完整 Fable 模型 ID 的`/model`，当计划需要尚未打开的使用积分时，它会在 API 错误处停止，而不是打开使用积分提示

entries.en: Fixed requests failing for up to a minute with an "another Claude Code process is refreshing it" login error after that other process was closed or killed mid-refresh
entries.zh: 修复了在刷新过程中关闭或终止其他进程后，请求失败长达一分钟并出现“另一个克劳德代码进程正在刷新它”登录错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed sessions started while another Claude Code window was refreshing the sign-in (common with several VS Code windows) not retrying their organization policy fetch
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个 Claude Code 窗口刷新登录（常见于多个 VS Code 窗口）时启动的会话，而不重试其组织策略提取的问题

entries.en: Fixed CLAUDE.md and rules being read at startup through a repository symlink reaching macOS's `/Network` via `..` or a `/.vol`-style kernel path, or a rules link to macOS's `/home` being listed
entries.zh: 修复了启动时通过存储库符号链接读取的 CLAUDE.md 和规则，该存储库符号链接通过`..`或`/.vol`样式内核路径到达 macOS 的`/Network`，或者列出了指向 macOS`/home`的规则链接

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission rules with a mid-pattern `:*` being skipped in settings files while `--allowedTools` honored them; they now work from every source, with a startup warning on how they match
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限规则，在设置文件中跳过中间模式`:*`，而`--allowedTools`则遵循它们；他们现在可以从各个来源工作，并有关于他们如何匹配的启动警告

entries.en: Fixed a command approved on a restored permission prompt running twice when a remote session's worker restarted
entries.zh: 修复了在远程会话的工作人员重新启动时运行两次的恢复权限提示下批准的命令

entries.en: Fixed managed settings ignoring a mistyped value for boolean lock keys such as `disableClaudeAiConnectors` or `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`; the lock now applies and startup names the key
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置忽略布尔锁键输入错误的值，例如`disableClaudeAiConnectors`或`allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`；现在锁已应用，并且启动程序命名了密钥

entries.en: Fixed managed `permissions`, `autoMode`, `worktree` and `attribution` settings being ignored entirely when one nested value was invalid; the rest of the block now still applies
entries.zh: 修复了当一个嵌套值无效时，托管的`permissions`、`autoMode`、`worktree`和`attribution`设置被完全忽略的问题；该块的其余部分现在仍然适用

entries.en: Fixed repository, user and `--add-dir` skills, commands and skills-directory plugin manifests pre-approving their own tools via `allowed-tools` under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`
entries.zh: 修复了存储库、用户和`--add-dir`技能、命令和技能目录插件清单，通过托管`allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`下的`allowed-tools`预先批准自己的工具

entries.en: Fixed safeguard block messages on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock Mantle not showing a request ID; block messages now also show the message ID
entries.zh: 修复了 Amazon Bedrock 和 Bedrock Mantle 上的防护阻止消息不显示请求 ID 的问题；阻止消息现在还显示消息 ID

entries.en: Vertex AI: Fixed web search not being offered for models Claude Code doesn't recognize yet, such as newly released ones
entries.zh: Vertex AI：修复了 Claude Code 尚不认识的新发布模型（如刚发布的）未提供网页搜索的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash and PowerShell hiding a full disk quota behind "Exit code 1" and leaving large output files in temp
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 和 PowerShell 将完整磁盘配额隐藏在“退出代码 1”后面并将大型输出文件留在临时文件中的问题

entries.en: Fixed tool input validation errors naming only an unknown, missing or mistyped parameter when other parameters in the same call were also invalid; those are now listed too
entries.zh: 修复工具输入校验错误只指出未知、缺失或类型错误的一个参数，而同一调用中的其他参数也有错误时未列出它们的问题；现在会一并列出

entries.en: Fixed pasted multi-line text being submitted line by line after the terminal's bracketed paste mode was reset mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了在会话中重置终端的括号粘贴模式后逐行提交粘贴的多行文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed the prompt's example text flashing and disappearing at startup in projects with a `SessionStart` hook
entries.zh: 修复在带有 `SessionStart` 钩子的项目中，启动时提示框的示例文字闪烁并消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a blank screen flashing before the first frame when starting in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了以全屏模式启动时第一帧之前闪烁的空白屏幕

entries.en: Fixed garbled, misplaced rows in the non-fullscreen renderer after the screen got shorter while still taller than the terminal, e.g. deleting a prompt line while a shell command streams output
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕变短但仍比终端高后非全屏渲染器中乱码、错位的行，例如在 shell 命令流输出时删除提示行

entries.en: Fixed a stale character left in the last column of a diff when a redrawn line's CJK character or emoji wrapped to the next row
entries.zh: 修复了当重绘行的 CJK 字符或表情符号换行到下一行时，差异最后一列中留下的过时字符

entries.en: Fixed the cursor landing before the end of a prompt recalled from history when the prompt contains a tab
entries.zh: 修复从历史记录召回的提示词包含制表符时，光标落在末尾之前的问题

entries.en: Fixed the send-now hint showing ctrl+enter on terminals that send it as a newline (Windows Terminal before 1.25); it now shows ctrl+x ctrl+s there
entries.zh: 修复在把 ctrl+enter 当作换行发送的终端（1.25 之前的 Windows Terminal）中，"立即发送"提示仍显示 ctrl+enter 的问题；现在该终端会显示 ctrl+x ctrl+s

entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control --debug` failing with "Unknown argument: --debug", although Remote Control's own eligibility error says to run with `--debug`
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Remote-control --debug”失败并显示“未知参数：--debug”的问题，尽管远程控制自身的资格错误表明要使用`--debug`运行

entries.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` saying "cancelled" and then still pushing the branch and saving the API key secret; leaving now stops the remaining steps and reports what was already done
entries.zh: 修复了 `/install-github-app` 说“已取消”，然后仍然推送分支并保存 API 密钥秘密；现在离开将停止剩余步骤并报告已完成的操作

entries.en: Fixed /feedback, /bug and /share on Bedrock, Vertex and other third-party providers still saving the report file after you cancelled during the save
entries.zh: 修复了在保存过程中取消后，Bedrock、Vertex 和其他第三方提供商仍然保存报告文件的 /feedback、/bug 和 /share

entries.en: Fixed plugin uninstall reporting success and deleting the plugin's saved options when its settings file still enabled it or could not be read; it now stops and names the file
entries.zh: 修复了插件卸载报告成功并在其设置文件仍然启用或无法读取时删除插件的已保存选项的问题；它现在停止并命名该文件

entries.en: Fixed plugin uninstall deleting a plugin's saved options and secrets when the list of installed plugins could not be read after the removal; they are now kept and the uninstall says so
entries.zh: 修复了插件卸载在删除后无法读取已安装插件列表时删除插件保存的选项和机密的问题；它们现在被保留，卸载也是如此

entries.en: Fixed a key typed right after `/` in `/skills` moving the skill list instead of reaching the search box
entries.zh: 修复了在`/skills`中的`/`之后立即键入的键会移动技能列表而不是到达搜索框

entries.en: Fixed the terminal cursor jumping from the `/skills` search box to the skill list while typing, which could hide the caret and put IME input in the wrong place
entries.zh: 修复输入时终端光标从 `/skills` 搜索框跳到技能列表，导致插入符被隐藏、输入法输入位置错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed lists with a scrollbar, such as `/skills` and `/mcp`, being two columns narrower outside fullscreen mode, where the scrollbar can never appear
entries.zh: 修复了带有滚动条的列表，例如`/skills`和`/mcp`，在全屏模式下两列变窄，滚动条永远不会出现

entries.en: Fixed the agent panel footer wrapping onto two lines with long rebound keys, and its "Esc to collapse" hint ignoring a rebound collapse key
entries.zh: 修复快捷键重新绑定为长文本时，智能体面板页脚换行成两行，以及"Esc to collapse"提示忽略已重绑定的折叠键的问题

entries.en: Fixed a doubled ` · ` separator in the `/tasks` dialog footer when the stop-all-agents shortcut is unbound in `keybindings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了当`keybindings.json`中取消绑定“停止所有代理”快捷方式时，`/tasks`对话框页脚中的双“·”分隔符

entries.en: Fixed artifact publishes failing when Claude gave the version a label longer than 60 characters; the label is now shortened
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude 为版本指定的标签长度超过 60 个字符时工件发布失败的问题；标签现已缩短

entries.en: Fixed screen-reader mode, quoted lists and very long lists dropping the blank lines at the top of a code block that opens a list item, directly or inside a quote
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式、引用列表和非常长的列表，直接或在引用内删除打开列表项的代码块顶部的空白行

entries.en: Fixed PDF page-read error messages: paths with accented or non-Latin characters now appear readably, and a folder named like "password" or "invalid" can no longer make the error name the wrong cause
entries.zh: 修复了 PDF 页面读取错误消息：带有重音字符或非拉丁字符的路径现在可读，并且名为“密码”或“无效”的文件夹不再使错误名称成为错误原因

entries.en: Fixed vim mode `>>` indenting empty lines, `r` with a count longer than the line changing text, `2J` joining one line too many, and a count on the last line (`2dd`, `2>>`) shifting or deleting it
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下 `>>` 会缩进空行、`r` 带计数超过行长时会改写文本、`2J` 多合并一行，以及在最后一行使用计数（`2dd`、`2>>`）会错误移动或删除该行的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode cursor placement: after `dd`, `dj`, `dG` or a whole-line `p`/`P` it lands on the first non-blank, `yy` no longer moves it, and Esc after an emoji no longer leaves it inside the emoji
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式光标定位：执行 `dd`、`dj`、`dG` 或整行 `p`/`P` 后，光标落在第一个非空白字符上；`yy` 不再移动光标；emoji 后按 Esc 不再让光标停在 emoji 内部

entries.en: Fixed vim mode ignoring a count typed before `.` when repeating `x`, `s`, `p`, `d` or `c`, and whole-line `p`/`P`, `o`, `O`, `J`, `>>` and `<<` acting on the wrong line when a line above wraps
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，在 `.` 前输入计数后重复 `x`、`s`、`p`、`d` 或 `c` 时计数被忽略，以及上一行换行时整行 `p`/`P`、`o`、`O`、`J`、`>>` 和 `<<` 作用于错误行的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor past the end of a prompt recalled from history or pulled back from the queue in normal mode, so `x` did nothing
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，从历史召回或从队列拉回的提示词，在普通模式下光标越过末尾导致 `x` 无效的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed long replies falling behind the stream: the panel no longer re-parses the whole reply on every update
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复长回复跟不上流式输出的问题：面板不再在每次更新时重新解析整个回复

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the dictation mic button covering the message input's scrollbar when the input is tall enough to scroll
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复输入框内容高到可以滚动时，听写麦克风按钮遮住输入框滚动条的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Remote Control sessions started on this computer not opening from their Web entry in the session list; they now open the local conversation unless it's running elsewhere
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在本机发起的 Remote Control 会话，从会话列表的 Web 入口无法打开的问题；现在除非该会话正在其他地方运行，否则会打开本地对话

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed an editor tab's sign-in screen hanging silently after the extension host restarts; it now shows the "stopped responding" notice too
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展宿主重启后，编辑器标签页的登录界面静默卡住的问题；现在也会显示 "stopped responding" 提示

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the next run time shown for an hourly routine being 30 minutes off for people in half-hour-offset time zones such as India
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复每小时运行的例程，在印度等有半小时时差的时区中，显示的下次运行时间偏差 30 分钟的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed auto-join channel patterns saved for one workspace in Claude Tag admin settings being ignored on an Enterprise Grid org-wide install; Claude now joins matching new channels
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在 Claude Tag 管理设置中为某工作区保存的自动加入频道规则，在 Enterprise Grid 组织范围安装中被忽略的问题；现在 Claude 会加入符合规则的新频道

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude not responding in an Enterprise Grid channel shared between two workspaces of one organization when the channel's Claude Tag version was saved from the other workspace
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复同一组织两个工作区共享的 Enterprise Grid 频道中，若该频道的 Claude Tag 版本是在另一个工作区保存的，Claude 不回应的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the earlier Claude in Slack app's progress card for sessions on a GitHub Enterprise Server repository: it now names the repository and offers a working Create PR button
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复较早的 Claude in Slack 应用，在 GitHub Enterprise Server 仓库会话中的进度卡片问题：现在会显示仓库名称，并提供可用的 Create PR 按钮

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Slack threads whose model has been retired falling back to another model on every reply, slower and with a fallback note each time; the thread now moves to a working model
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 话题的模型已退役时，每次回复都改用其他模型（更慢，且每次都附带备用模型说明）的问题；现在该话题会切换到可用的模型

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed files Claude uploads to Slack not being able to carry a caption containing a table; captions now render with the same formatting as replies
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 上传到 Slack 的文件无法在说明文字中包含表格的问题；说明文字现在与回复使用相同的格式

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude's threads in Slack's Agents & tools view sometimes being listed under their first message instead of their name; later renames now update the list too
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 在 Slack「Agents & tools」视图中的话题，有时以首条消息而非话题名称列出的问题；之后的重命名也会同步更新列表

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed removing a GitHub organization's grant from an access bundle's Repositories tab in Claude Tag admin settings failing to save after that GitHub organization was disconnected
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 GitHub 组织断开连接后，在 Claude Tag 管理设置访问包的 Repositories 标签页中移除该组织授权，保存失败的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude always replying "Couldn't check this channel just now" in a channel shared with a Grid workspace it isn't added to; the notice now says which workspace needs the app
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在未添加 Claude 的 Grid 工作区所共享的频道中，Claude 总是回复「Couldn't check this channel just now」的问题；通知现在会说明哪个工作区需要安装应用

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the cost and token totals in Claude's reply footer reading many times too high after the session's cloud worker restarted
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复会话的云端工作进程重启后，Claude 回复页脚中的费用和 token 总数被高估数倍的问题
